name: Boukensha no Machi o Tsukurou! 2
source:
The village you live in will be attacked by all kinds of monsters as the story expands.
As the owner of the village, you'll need to recruit beautiful adventurers, use magic, build walls, turrets to defend it.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/727090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
随着故事推进，你所居住的村庄会受到各种怪物的袭击。作为村庄的主人，你需要招募美丽的冒险者、使用魔法、建造城墙与炮塔来保护村庄。

[译自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/727090/]Steam[/url]]
